第17章 灵桃保卫战一（第1页）
由于桃山庄外的灵桃园栽植的灵桃树大部分为一阶下品灵桃树，只有一少部分是一阶中品灵桃树。
所以，聚集在灵桃园外的妖兽也是以一阶下品妖兽为主，只有个别妖兽达到一阶中品。
同修仙者一样，妖兽对有助于提高自己实力灵物的追逐，一点不比修仙者差，且更加残酷。
桃山刘氏家族，由于处于青云山脉外围，离妖兽活动区域太近，常年遭受妖兽袭击，特别是灵果成熟时，更是吸引大批低阶妖兽前来觅食。
当前，聚集在桃山周围的妖兽主要有长耳猕猴、黑山熊、青风兔、金角鹿、黑角羊。妖禽有青云雀、火云鸡，黑风鹤等等。各类妖兽妖禽达四五百只。
刘长旭所在二队，队长是二长老刘秋水，副队长是六长老刘世盛。炼气中期的队员有三伯父刘世杰、十三叔刘世举、大哥刘长勇、四姐刘长玉。
按照事前安排，二队在二长老刘秋水的带领下，向着其中一处灵桃园而去。
此时一群妖兽正在攻击守护这处灵桃园的桃阵。
桃阵虽是一阶中品阵法，且威力也不够强大，但是，桃阵能够在无人操控的情况下利用灵桃园内的木灵气幻化成桃攻击入侵敌人。当然，有人操控的效果更佳。
很快二队的家族修士就与妖兽战斗在一起。
二长老刘秋水在前方开路，六长老刘世盛在断后，刘长旭等五名炼气中期修士在左右两边掩护炼气初期的家族修士向前推进，众人也不和妖兽纠缠，向着灵桃园而去。
二长老刘秋水挥动手中法器长刀，一道道长达数丈火红刀气不断的向着前方的妖兽砍去。
一头一阶下品的金角鹿一个躲闪不及，被火红的刀气一劈两半。
但是，妖兽太多了，妖兽们并没有后退，而是将火力对准了二长老刘秋水。
一时间十多只妖兽发出的火球、水箭、风刃向着二长老刘秋水而来。
二长老刘秋水赶紧向后退去，而妖兽也利用这次机会再次包围了二队家族修士。
一时间，家族修士与妖兽的战斗处于白热化。

刘长旭就独自面对着三只一阶下品黑角羊，黑角羊的血脉妖术是黑角术，和金角鹿类似，能幻化成黑角进行攻击。
面对三只黑角羊，刘长旭一面手持龟甲盾，激发法力护住自己，一面御使龙泉剑施展风雨剑法，龙泉剑发出了一道道青色剑气对着其中一只黑角羊就是三剑，那只黑角羊躲闪不及，很快被刘长旭击杀。
看到这种情况，又一只一阶中品黑角羊冲了过来。
刘长旭一方面努力激发龟甲盾的最大防御力护住自己，挥动风雨剑法拦住了三只黑角羊。
刘长旭能以一敌三，其他族人可不一定能够办到。
其中，大哥刘长勇等三位族人已经受了不轻的伤。
其他族人也是抵挡的艰难，二长老刘秋水和六长老刘世盛更是每人对付六七只妖兽。
刘长旭见到形势不妙，赶紧向二长老刘秋水建议：“高祖父，我觉得这样不行啊！我手上有75张一阶下品火球符，都是我自己炼制的。你看这样行不，还有有火球符的都拿出来，我们集中祭出这些火球符攻击前方妖兽，应该能够冲到前面灵桃园。”

Chapter 17 Lingtao Defense Battle 1 (Page 1)
Since most of the spiritual peach trees planted in the spiritual peach garden outside Taoshan Villa are first-order low-grade spiritual peach trees, only a small part are first-order medium-grade spiritual peach trees.
Therefore, the monsters gathered outside Lingtaoyuan are mainly first-order low-grade monsters, and only a few monsters have reached the first-order mid-grade.
Just like the immortal cultivators, the monster beasts' pursuit of spiritual objects that can help improve their strength is no worse than the immortal cultivators, and more cruel.
The Taoshan Liu family is located on the outskirts of the Qingyun Mountains and is too close to the area where monsters live. They are attacked by monsters all year round. Especially when the spiritual fruits are ripe, they attract a large number of low-level monsters to come for food.
Currently, the monsters gathering around Taoshan mainly include long-eared macaques, black mountain bears, green wind rabbits, golden-horned deer, and black-horned sheep. The demon birds include blue skylark, fire cloud chicken, black wind crane and so on. There were four to five hundred monsters and birds of all kinds.
Liu Changxu is in the second team. The captain is the second elder Liu Qiushui and the vice-captain is the sixth elder Liu Shisheng. The team members in the middle stage of Qi refining include the third uncle Liu Shijie, the thirteenth uncle Liu Shiju, the eldest brother Liu Changyong, and the fourth sister Liu Changyu.
According to the pre-arrangement, the second team, led by the second elder Liu Qiushui, headed for one of the spiritual peach gardens.
At this time, a group of monsters are attacking the peach array guarding this spiritual peach garden.
Although the Peach Formation is a first-level mid-level formation and its power is not strong enough, the Peach Formation can use the wood spirit energy in the peach garden to transform into peaches to attack the invading enemies without human control. Of course, the effect is better when someone controls it.
Soon the second team of family monks were fighting with the monsters.
The second elder Liu Qiushui opened the way in front, the sixth elder Liu Shisheng was behind, Liu Changxu and other five middle-stage Qi-refining monks were on the left and right to cover the early-stage Qi-refining family monks as they moved forward. Everyone stopped entangled with the monsters and headed towards the Lingtaoyuan.
The second elder Liu Qiushui waved the long sword in his hand, and slashed at the monster in front of him with fiery red sword energy that was several feet long.
A first-level low-grade golden-horned deer was unable to dodge and was split in half by the fiery red sword energy.
However, there were too many monsters. The monsters did not retreat, but aimed their firepower at the second elder Liu Qiushui.
At one time, more than a dozen monster beasts fired fireballs, water arrows, and wind blades towards the second elder Liu Qiushui.
Second Elder Liu Qiushui quickly retreated, and the monsters also used this opportunity to surround the second team of family monks again.
For a time, the battle between the family monks and the monsters became intense.
Liu Changxu faced three first-level low-grade black-horned sheep alone. The black-horned sheep's blood magic is the black horn technique, which is similar to the golden-horned deer and can transform into black horns to attack.
Facing the three black-horned sheep, Liu Changxu held a tortoise shell shield and activated his magic power to protect himself. At the same time, he used Longquan Sword to perform the wind and rain sword technique. Longquan Sword sent out green sword energy and struck three swords at one of the black-horned sheep. The black-horned sheep could not dodge and was quickly killed by Liu Changxu.
Seeing this situation, another first-level middle-grade black-horned sheep rushed over.
On the one hand, Liu Changxu tried his best to activate the maximum defensive power of the turtle shield to protect himself, and stopped the three black-horned sheep with the wind and rain sword technique.
Liu Changxu can fight one against three, but other tribesmen may not be able to do it.
Among them, the eldest brother Liu Changyong and three other tribesmen had been seriously injured.
Other clan members also had a hard time resisting. Second Elder Liu Qiushui and Sixth Elder Liu Shisheng each had to deal with six or seven monsters.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Liu Changxu quickly suggested to the second elder Liu Qiushui: "Great-great-grandfather, I don't think this will work! I have 75 first-level low-grade fireball talismans in my hand, all of which I refined myself. Do you think this will work? Bring out those who have fireball talismans. Let's focus on using these fireball talismans to attack the monsters in front of us.We should be able to rush to the front of Lingtaoyuan. "
